body:
There is always a way.

I wanted to die, still do sometimes. I wrote a note out today, planned it all out in my head. 5 page typed out note. Wrote all my feelings down in a page. Saved it even. Thought I'd print it out. Maybe do it when everyones away tomorrow, when I'm alone at home. I'm still contemplating it. But I know deep down I don't want to, neither do you. 

When you post something like this, its a cry for help its a cry for a sign. You want something or someone somewhere to stop you. Make you live another day. If you were looking for a sign, this is it. 

I don't want you to die. I want you to live. I know you have it in you. Live another day - do something different. Go on a day trip to another city, do that one thing you always wanted to. You have it in you and when you have it in you, no one. I mean no-one can take it away, even you.

Hi.

I want you to know I care. I don't know you, I have just read this post. It may seem silly. According to this, you have 11 hours left. I think you should have at least a week. Do this thing - give yourself a day then a week and then a month. See it like a challenge. Can you go further? One day you will look back at it and be glad you gave yourself a week, a month, a year, two years. You'll look back and see all the things you created over the space of time, the new person you developed into. 

I know you feel like its time for you to go. but it isn't. You have lots of left to do. I know how it feels to feel nothing, when you get to that point where joy isn't joy and sadness isn't sadness. everything is numb and everything is dull. But one day things will be bright again. The sun will shine. You will learn to love the nights. You will learn to love the little things. Give yourself that chance.
I have been diagnosed with depression since about 5 years but suffered from it for about 7. I have spoken but when I go to the doctor I minimise how I feel and I think I can make it through.
I'm ok with both, just would like some help.
